code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and monocytosis, with elevated eosinophils and basophils. There is also mild hypoproteinemia, low total CO₂, and mild hyperchloremia. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, possible bone marrow suppression or dysregulation, and mild metabolic acidosis. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
